name: apostille
title: Apostille
description: A notary's theme drawn as a bound notarial act: bright-white deed paper with a ruled margin, a twisted navy-and-white cord sewn down it through punched eyelets into a serrated gold-foil seal, and the services set out as numbered clauses.

tokens.--font-text: the transitional serif of running text, titles, clauses and fees
tokens.--font-caps: the letterspaced capitals: firm name, menu, labels, block headings, the back link and the registration line
tokens.--text-small: small print: credentials, the masthead telephone, clause numbers, direct lines, tags, the foot of the act
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of the small capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the deed paper: page background, and the paper hiding the cord below the seal
tokens.--color-text: blue-black ink: text, titles, the masthead double rule, rules above lists and people, the appointment frame, focus rings
tokens.--color-muted: quieter ink: introductions, service descriptions, clause numbers, labels, credentials, dates, the foot of the act
tokens.--color-accent: the gold foil of the seal, used nowhere else
tokens.--color-foil-line: rings and beads pressed into the foil seal
tokens.--color-link: links in text, the back link, people’s e-mail and phone links
tokens.--color-strand-a: first strand of the twisted cord, and its edges
tokens.--color-strand-b: second strand of the twisted cord
tokens.--color-eyelet: metal ring of each punched eyelet
tokens.--color-hole: the dark punched hole the cord passes into
tokens.--color-margin-rule: the ruled double line beside the binding margin, and the rule beside quotes
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines between clauses, hour rows, table rows and news items, and beside block headings
tokens.--color-panel: tinted ground of the appointment block and behind code
tokens.--page-width: widest the act gets, margin included
tokens.--margin-width: width of the binding margin, narrower on a phone
tokens.--twist: width of one strand’s stripe in the twist
tokens.--eyelet-pitch: distance from one pair of eyelets to the next
tokens.--eyelet-gap: distance between the two eyelets of a pair, where the cord runs behind the paper
tokens.--fee-width: width of the fee column beside each clause on a wide screen
tokens.--gutter: space at each side of the page
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: under a label, between a name and its role
tokens.--space-2: small gap inside rows and between short lines
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and inside a clause
tokens.--space-5: gap between the page and the appointment block
